questions.question: In what month and year does Anna Pávlovna Schérer's reception take place?
Whose maid of honor and favorite was Anna Pávlovna Schérer?
Which post did Prince Vasíli want for his son, the one Baron Funke was being recommended for?
How much does Prince Vasíli say Anatole is costing him a year?
Which book did Pierre take from the shelf in Prince Andrew's study while waiting for him?
What was the name of the doll Natásha brought into the drawing room on her name day?
Which doctor had come from Petersburg to attend the dying Count Bezúkhov?
Near what building was the large house in which Anatole lived in Petersburg?
On which Moscow street is the Countess Rostóva's big house?
What did Dólokhov wager he would drink while sitting on the outer window ledge, and for how much?
Into which waterway were the policeman and the bear put, tied back to back?
What are the first name and patronymic of Pierre's father, Count Bezúkhov, as the text gives them?
How many children had the Countess Rostóva borne?
Who is the colonel of the Pávlograd Hussars dining with the Rostóvs and taking Nicholas back with him?
What nickname was Princess Mary Bolkónskaya's father given after he retired from the army?
The hostess of the July soirée said she was ill with something whose name was then a fashionable new word in the capital. What was it?
What was the main gossip among the callers congratulating the Rostóvs on the name day?
What stinging nickname had the Rostóvs' son given his elder sister, which the younger ones shouted at her through the door?
Whose scheme for ending war forever did the awkward young guest call interesting but hardly feasible?
Which celebrated actress figured in the émigré's anecdote about the murdered duke and the usurper?
Why did Pierre tell his friend he would not join the present war against Napoleon?
Who promised Anna Pávlovna he would be her devoted 'slafe with an f' if she arranged a match for him?
What position had been waiting for the Rostóvs' eldest son before he chose the army instead?
The count boasts that his youngest daughter will be a singer, a second whom?
How much did the widowed princess tell her old friend she needed to fit out her officer son, and how much did she actually have?
The elderly lady who sat beside Anna Pávlovna's aunt pleaded with Prince Vasíli for her son. Into which regiment was the son transferred as a result?
Who is the godfather of the son for whom Princess Drubetskáya petitioned Prince Vasíli?
Whose father hushed up his son's part in the scandal that followed the party where Dólokhov drank the rum, and what happened to that son all the same?
Anna Pávlovna proposed a bride for Prince Vasíli's prodigal son. Who is the bride's brother, and whose aide-de-camp is he going to be?
Pierre gave Prince Andrew his word of honor not to go somewhere that night. Where did he go instead, and where was he sent afterwards?
Who is the mother of the officer who drank the bottle of rum on the window ledge?
The man who asked Anna Pávlovna to 'educate this bear' is said in Moscow to be a rival heir to whose fortune?
In whose house was Pierre staying in Petersburg, and to whom was that family planning to marry the son Pierre caroused with?
What did the little princess promise Anna Pávlovna in the hall ('It is settled'), and whose consent was still needed?
Julie Karágina flirted with young Rostóv at the name day. What is her mother's name?
For whose sake, according to the count, is Nicholas leaving the university, and what rank did that friend receive in the Guards?
Anna Mikháylovna relied on one grandee to get her son into the Guards and hopes another will pay for his equipment. Who are they?
In whose house was Borís educated from childhood, and what name do the two people celebrating their name day there share?
In what language did Prince Hippolyte tell his Moscow anecdote, and whom had he promised to take home afterwards?
What does Prince Andrew's wife call Kutúzov, and with whom will she live in the country while Andrew is at the war?
With which man did the Countess Rostóva once act in theatricals, and at whose house?
What is the first name of the Countess Rostóva's husband, and who manages all his affairs?
Who is the girl of fifteen who followed Natásha into the drawing room, and what did Nicholas later copy out for her?
Borís, for whom Prince Vasíli spoke to the Emperor, stayed in Moscow for his equipment. Where was he to join the Guards on their march?
Pierre came back to Moscow in disgrace. What does Count Rostóv ask Anna Mikháylovna to do about him when she leaves for Count Bezúkhov's?
Which Anna hosted the soirée in Petersburg in July 1805?
Which Anna begged Prince Vasíli to have her son transferred to the Guards?
The Countess Rostóva calls her childhood friend 'Annette'. Which Anna is that?
Which of Prince Vasíli's sons did Anna Pávlovna say she did not like?
Which of Prince Vasíli's sons brought the vicomte to Anna Pávlovna's and introduced him?
Who sat on the outer window ledge and drank a whole bottle of rum for a wager?
Who was the host of the party at which the rum wager took place, translating its terms into English for the Englishman?
Which of the young men in the bear affair was degraded to the ranks?
Which Rostóv girl is thirteen and ran in with a doll?
Which girl at the Rostóvs' is the count's fifteen-year-old niece?
In the conservatory, which girl jumped onto a tub and kissed Borís?
Of the two friends, the student and the officer, which one is short with curly hair?
Which of the Rostóv daughters did the countess bring up more strictly?
Which grandee of Catherine's time lay dying in Moscow in the summer of 1805?
Which nobleman called Pierre a bear and asked Anna Pávlovna to educate him?
Which Princess Bolkónskaya is pregnant and was called the most fascinating woman in Petersburg?
Which Princess Bolkónskaya is said to be very unhappy with her father and was proposed as a bride for Anatole?
Which young man in the text is going to the war as General Kutúzov's aide-de-camp?
Which young man is leaving the university to join the Pávlograd Hussars?
Which princess at Anna Pávlovna's wore a white dress trimmed with moss and ivy?
At which battle did Prince Andrew fall wounded while carrying a standard?
Where was Pierre's duel with Dólokhov fought?
In what year did Napoleon's Grande Armée invade Russia, and which river did it cross?
At which battle did Pierre watch the fighting from the Raévski redoubt?
Which governor of Moscow handed Vereshchágin over to the crowd?
On which family estate did the author write this novel?
Whom did the author of this novel marry in 1862?
What is the name of Prince Bolkónski's country estate, where Lise is to stay?
What are the first name and patronymic of Prince Andrew's father?
Who commanded Nicholas Rostóv's squadron in the Pávlograd Hussars?
What did Lise and Prince Andrew name their son?
How much did Nicholas Rostóv lose to Dólokhov at cards?
Who stopped Natásha's attempt to elope with Anatole Kurágin?
In which battle was Nicholas Rostóv first wounded?
What did Anna Mikháylovna and Prince Vasíli struggle over outside the dying Count Bezúkhov's room?
